description:
As a registered student of StudentTrack
  I want to sign in with my email and password
  So that I can view my subjects and attendance

elements.name: Approved student logs in with valid credentials

steps.name: the student is on the login page
the student enters a valid email and password
the student should be taken to the student dashboard
the dashboard should greet the student by name
the student is on the login page
the student enters a valid email and an incorrect password
the error message "Invalid login credentials" should be displayed
the student should remain on the login page

name: Student login
